title: adhatoda acuminata
intro: Adhatoda acuminata, commonly known as Vasa or Adulsa, is a tropical plant native to the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis, asthma, and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Adhatoda acuminata include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and act as a digestive aid. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include vasicine, vasicinone, and adenine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
